note: RFC 4271 Section 9.2 requires removing routes in Loc-RIB marked as unfeasible. TestLocRIBMirror installs a BGP route into Loc-RIB via checkBestPathChange, removes its sole Adj-RIB-In entry, re-runs checkBestPathChange, and asserts the prefix is absent from Loc-RIB. Both live route-server negative tests (TestRFC4271RouteServerStillFeasibleRouteIsNotWithdrawn and TestRFC4271RouteServerStillFeasibleRouteStaysInLocRIB) prove that announcing and withdrawing a worse route from peer B leaves peer A's still-feasible best route in Loc-RIB and sends no withdrawal or re-announcement on the client wire.
